readings.title: Thirsting for the Presence of Elohim
readings.subtitle: As a deer longs for water, so my being longs for You.
readings.text: [Psalm 42:1] As a deer longs for the water streams, So my being longs for <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>. [2] My being thirsts for <dn>Elohim</dn>, for the living <dn>Ěl</dn>. When shall I enter in to appear before <dn>Elohim</dn>? [3] My tears have been my food day and night, While they say to me all day, “Where is <dn>your</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>?” [4] These I remember, and pour out my being within me. For I used to pass along with the throng; I went with them to the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, With the voice of joy and praise, A multitude celebrating a festival! [5] Why are you depressed, O my being? And why are you restless within me? Wait for <dn>Elohim</dn>: for I shall yet thank <dn>Him</dn>, For the deliverance of <dn>His</dn> face!

readings.title: Hope in the Midst of Despair
readings.subtitle: Deep calls to deep at the sound of Your waterfalls.
readings.text: [Psalm 42:6] O my <dn>Elohim</dn>, my being is depressed within me; Therefore I remember <dn>You</dn> from the land of the Yarděn, And from the heights of Ḥermon, From Mount Mits‛ar. [7] Deep calls to deep at the sound of <dn>Your</dn> waterfalls; All <dn>Your</dn> waves and breakers passed over me. [8] By day <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commands <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, And by night <dn>His</dn> song is with me; A prayer to the <dn>Ěl</dn> of my life. [9] I say to <dn>Ěl</dn> my Rock, “Why have <dn>You</dn> forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?” [10] With murder in my bones, My enemies have reproached me, While they say to me all day long, “Where is <dn>your</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>?” [11] Why are you depressed, O my being? And why are you restless within me? Wait for <dn>Elohim</dn>: for I shall yet thank <dn>Him</dn>, the deliverance of my face, And my <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: A Plea for Light and Truth
readings.subtitle: Send forth Your light and Your truth! Let them lead me.
readings.text: [Psalm 43:1] Rule me rightly, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, And plead my cause against a nation without loving-commitment. Oh, deliver me from a man of deceit and unrighteousness! [2] For <dn>You</dn> are the <dn>Elohim</dn> of my strength. Why have <dn>You</dn> rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy? [3] Send forth <dn>Your</dn> light and <dn>Your</dn> truth! Let them lead me, Let them bring me to <dn>Your</dn> set-apart mountain And to <dn>Your</dn> dwelling places. [4] That I might come to the slaughter-place of <dn>Elohim</dn>, To <dn>Ěl</dn>, the joy of my delight, And praise <dn>You</dn> with the lyre, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, my <dn>Elohim</dn>. [5] Why are you depressed, O my being? And why are you restless within me? Wait for <dn>Elohim</dn>: for I shall yet thank <dn>Him</dn>, the deliverance of my face, And my <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: Remembering Past Deliverances
readings.subtitle: Not by their own sword did they possess the land, but it was Your right hand and Your arm.
readings.text: [Psalm 44:1] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, we have heard with our ears, Our fathers have related to us, The work <dn>You</dn> did in their days, In the days of old. [2] <dn>You</dn> drove out the nations with <dn>Your</dn> hand, But them <dn>You</dn> planted. <dn>You</dn> afflicted peoples, and sent them out. [3] For not by their own sword did they possess the land, Neither did their own arm save them; But it was <dn>Your</dn> right hand and <dn>Your</dn> arm, And the light of <dn>Your</dn> face, Because <dn>You</dn> delighted in them. [4] <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> are my Sovereign, O <dn>Elohim</dn>; Command deliverances for Ya‛aqoḇ. [5] Through <dn>You</dn> we push our enemies; Through <dn>Your</dn> Name we tread down those who rise up against us. [6] For I do not trust in my bow, And my sword does not save me. [7] For <dn>You</dn> have saved us from our enemies, And have put to shame those who hated us. [8] In <dn>Elohim</dn> we shall boast all day long, And praise <dn>Your</dn> Name forever. Selah.

readings.title: The Present Humiliation
readings.subtitle: Yet You have rejected us and put us to shame, and You do not go with our armies.
readings.text: [Psalm 44:9] Yet <dn>You</dn> have rejected us and put us to shame, And <dn>You</dn> do not go with our armies. [10] <dn>You</dn> make us turn back from the adversary, And those who hate us have plundered us. [11] <dn>You</dn> do give us as sheep to be eaten, And <dn>You</dn> have scattered us among the nations. [12] <dn>You</dn> sell <dn>Your</dn> people for no value, And have set no high price on them. [13] <dn>You</dn> make us a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and a mockery to those round about us. [14] <dn>You</dn> make us a proverb among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples. [15] My reproach is always before me, And the shame of my face has covered me, [16] Because of the voice of the slanderer and blasphemer, Because of the enemy and avenger.

readings.title: A Plea for God to Awaken
readings.subtitle: Arise, be our help, and redeem us for Your loving-commitment’ sake.
readings.text: [Psalm 44:17] All this has come upon us; But we have not forgotten <dn>You</dn>, Neither have we been false to <dn>Your</dn> covenant. [18] Our heart has not turned back, Neither has our step swerved from <dn>Your</dn> way, [19] Yet <dn>You</dn> have crushed us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death. [20] If we have forgotten the Name of our <dn>Elohim</dn>, Or stretched out our hands to a foreign mighty one, [21] Would <dn>Elohim</dn> not search this out? For <dn>He</dn> knows the secrets of the heart. [22] But for <dn>Your</dn> sake we are killed all day long; Reckoned as sheep for the slaughter. [23] Awake! Why do <dn>You</dn> sleep, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? Arise! Do not reject us forever. [24] Why do <dn>You</dn> hide <dn>Your</dn> face, Ignoring our affliction and our oppression? [25] For our being is bowed down to the dust; Our body cleaves to the earth. [26] Arise, be our help, And redeem us for <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment’ sake.

readings.title: A Song for the Anointed King
readings.subtitle: Your throne, O Elohim, is forever and ever.
readings.text: [Psalm 45:1] My heart is overflowing with a goodly word; I address my works to the Sovereign; My tongue is the pen of a speedy writer. [2] <dn>You</dn> are more handsome than the sons of men; Favour has been poured upon <dn>Your</dn> lips; Therefore <dn>Elohim</dn> has blessed <dn>You</dn> forever. [3] Gird <dn>Your</dn> sword upon <dn>Your</dn> thigh, O Mighty One, <dn>Your</dn> excellency and <dn>Your</dn> splendour. [4] And ride prosperously in <dn>Your</dn> splendour, On the matter of truth and humility, righteousness; And let <dn>Your</dn> right hand lead <dn>You</dn> to awesome matters. [5] <dn>Your</dn> arrows are sharp In the heart of the Sovereign’s enemies – Peoples fall under <dn>You</dn>. [6] <dn>Your</dn> throne, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, is forever and ever; The sceptre of <dn>Your</dn> reign Is a sceptre of straightness. [7] <dn>You</dn> have loved righteousness and hated wrongness; Therefore <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, has anointed <dn>You</dn> With the oil of gladness more than <dn>Your</dn> companions. [8] All <dn>Your</dn> garments are myrrh and aloes, cassia; Out of the palaces of ivory, Stringed instruments have made <dn>You</dn> glad. [9] Daughters of sovereigns are among <dn>Your</dn> precious ones; At <dn>Your</dn> right hand stands the sovereigness in gold from Ophir.

readings.title: An Address to the Royal Bride
readings.subtitle: Listen, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear.
readings.text: [Psalm 45:10] Listen, O daughter, and see, And incline your ear, And forget your own people and your father’s house; [11] And let the Sovereign delight in your loveliness; Because <dn>He</dn> is your Master – bow yourself to <dn>Him</dn>. [12] And the daughter of Tsor with a gift, The rich among the people seek your favour. [13] The daughter of the Sovereign Is all esteemed within the palace; Her dress is embroidered with gold. [14] She is brought to the Sovereign in embroidered work; Maidens, her companions following her, Are brought to <dn>You</dn>. [15] They are brought with gladness and rejoicing; They enter the Sovereign’s palace. [16] Instead of <dn>Your</dn> fathers are <dn>Your</dn> sons, Whom <dn>You</dn> appoint princes in all the earth. [17] I cause <dn>Your</dn> Name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the people praise <dn>You</dn> forever and ever.

readings.title: A Mighty Fortress
readings.subtitle: Elohim is our refuge and strength, a help in distress, soon found.
readings.text: [Psalm 46:1] <dn>Elohim</dn> is our refuge and strength, A help in distress, soon found. [2] Therefore we do not fear, Though the earth reels And mountains topple into the heart of the seas. [3] Let its waters rage, foam; Let mountains shake with its swelling. Selah. [4] A river whose streams Make glad the city of <dn>Elohim</dn>, The set-apart dwelling of the Most High. [5] <dn>Elohim</dn> is in her midst, she does not topple; <dn>Elohim</dn> does help her when morning turns. [6] The nations shall rage, Reigns shall topple; <dn>He</dn> shall give forth <dn>His</dn> voice, The earth melts. [7] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts is with us; The <dn>Elohim</dn> of Ya‛aqoḇ is our refuge. Selah.

readings.title: Be Still and Know
readings.subtitle: He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the chariot with fire.
readings.text: [Psalm 46:8] Come, see the works of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, The ruins <dn>He</dn> has wrought on the earth, [9] Causing all fighting to cease, Unto the end of the earth. <dn>He</dn> breaks the bow and shatters the spear; <dn>He</dn> burns the chariot with fire. [10] <dq>Be still, and know that <dn>I</dn> <dn>am</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>; <dn>I</dn> <dn>am</dn> exalted among nations, <dn>I</dn> <dn>am</dn> exalted in the earth!</dq> [11] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts is with us; The <dn>Elohim</dn> of Ya‛aqoḇ is our refuge. Selah.
